# Call Libraries

```{r}
#| output: false

# library(scatterplot3d)

library(car)

library(rgl)

library(haven)

library(dplyr)


```

# Get Data

```{r}
#| output: false

simulated_multilevel_longitudinal_data <- read_dta("simulated_multilevel_longitudinal_data.dta")

simulated_multilevel_longitudinal_data <- simulated_multilevel_longitudinal_data %>%
  filter(id < 1.15)
  
simulated_multilevel_longitudinal_data$id <- factor(simulated_multilevel_longitudinal_data$id)

```

# Three Dimensional Scatterplot / Spaghetti Plot

```{r}
#| message: false

clear3d()

scatter3d(simulated_multilevel_longitudinal_data$outcome ~ 
            simulated_multilevel_longitudinal_data$warmth +
            simulated_multilevel_longitudinal_data$t,
          groups = simulated_multilevel_longitudinal_data$id,
          surface.col = 1:30,
          surface = TRUE,
          xlab="x",
          zlab = "t",
          ylab = "Outcome")

text3d(x=0, y=1, z=0, 
       "Three Dimensional Scatterplot & Spaghetti Plot",
       cex = 2.0)

rglwidget()

```
